<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
People who want to join your group apply through Alagos. Each application is posted for your officers with its own thread for discussion, and an approval gives them their roles and puts them on the roster.

## 1. Set up a form

Open `/guild-settings show`, go to the **Panels** tab and press **📝 Applications**, then **➕ New form**. On the form:

- **✏️ Settings**: its name, the channel applications are posted in (an officer channel), whether you are taking applications, how many days someone waits to apply again after a Deny (7 by default; 0 for no wait), and whether a Deny shows the applicant your reason.
- **❓ Questions**: your own questions, one a line. End a line with **(optional)** if it may be left blank. A game adds its own first: in World of Warcraft, the character's name, realm, class, specs, item level, logs link and talent build, then raid experience and when they can raid.
- **The roles an approval gives**: pick them in the menu. Roles that carry moderation or admin permissions, or an Alagos permission, are refused.

## 2. Put the Apply button out

- **📌 Post the Apply button** posts it in a channel people can see.
- Or add **📝 Apply to join** as a step of your **👋 Welcome flow**, so newcomers can apply as they arrive.

## 3. Applying

Pressing **🧾 Apply** opens Discord's own forms: the character first, the specs from a menu, then the questions, five at a time. Nothing is sent until the last page. Each person can have one application waiting at a time.

## 4. Deciding

Each application is posted in your channel as a card, with a thread under it for the officers. On the card:

- **✅ Accept**: they get your roles, go on the roster with their character, and are told by direct message.
- **📋 With conditions**: the same, with conditions you write (a trial of four raids, say), sent to them.
- **🪑 Bench**: a good player you have no spot for right now. Pick the role they would fill; they are told you may reach out.
- **❌ Deny**: optionally with a reason. The applicant sees it only if your form says so.

Only one officer decides: a second press is told it was already decided. The card then says who decided and when, and its thread is locked. Officers with **Review applications** (in the Officer bundle) can decide; give it to a recruitment role in `/guild-settings permissions` if you like.

## 5. Premium

- Up to 15 of your own questions (3 on Free), several forms (Raider and Social, say), and your own line on the Apply post.
- **Voting**: officers vote for, against or abstain on the card, and the tally shows. Votes never decide by themselves.
- **🔍 Recruiting for…**: when you need a tank, see the tanks you benched, newest first, and **Reopen** one for a new decision.
- **📤 Export** your applications as a spreadsheet file.

Applications are deleted 180 days after they are decided; benched ones after 365.
{% endraw %}
